sn3.20:1.1: atha kho rājā pasenadikosalo divādivassa yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadikosalaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn3.20:1.2: handa kuto nu tvaṃ mahārāja āgacchasi divādivassāti.
sn3.20:2.1: idha bhante sāvatthiyaṃ seṭṭhī gahapati kālakato
sn3.20:2.2: tamahaṃ aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ rājantepuraṃ atiharitvā āgacchāmi
sn3.20:2.3: sataṃ bhante satasahassāni hiraññasseva ko pana vādo rūpiyassa
sn3.20:2.4: tassa kho pana bhante seṭṭhissa gahapatissa evarūpo bhattabhogo ahosi
sn3.20:3.2: bhūtapubbaṃ so mahārāja seṭṭhī gahapati tagarasikhiṃ nāma paccekasambuddhaṃ piṇḍapātena paṭipādesi
sn3.20:3.3: detha samaṇassa piṇḍanti vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi
sn3.20:3.4: datvā ca pana pacchā vippaṭisārī ahosi
sn3.20:3.5: varametaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dāsā vā kammakarā vā bhuñjeyyunti
sn3.20:3.6: bhātu ca pana ekaṃ puttakaṃ sāpateyyassa kāraṇā jīvitā voropesi.
sn3.20:4.1: yaṃ kho so mahārāja seṭṭhī gahapati tagarasikhiṃ paccekasambuddhaṃ piṇḍapātena paṭipādesi tassa kammassa vipākena sattakkhattuṃ sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajji
sn3.20:4.2: tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena imissāyeva sāvatthiyā sattakkhattuṃ seṭṭhittaṃ kāresi.
sn3.20:4.3: yaṃ kho so mahārāja seṭṭhī gahapati datvā pacchā vippaṭisārī ahosi
sn3.20:4.4: varametaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dāsā vā kammakarā vā bhuñjeyyunti tassa kammassa vipākena nāssuḷārāya bhattabhogāya cittaṃ namati nāssuḷārāya vatthabhogāya cittaṃ namati nāssuḷārāya yānabhogāya cittaṃ namati nāssuḷārānaṃ pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ bhogāya cittaṃ namati.
sn3.20:4.5: yaṃ kho so mahārāja seṭṭhī gahapati bhātu ca pana ekaṃ puttakaṃ sāpateyyassa kāraṇā jīvitā voropesi tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye paccittha
sn3.20:4.6: tasseva vassasatāni bahūni kammassa vipākāvasesena idaṃ sattamaṃ aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ rājakosaṃ pavesenti.
sn3.20:4.7: tassa kho pana mahārāja seṭṭhissa gahapatissa purāṇañca puññaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ navañca puññaṃ anupacitaṃ.
sn3.20:4.8: ajja pana mahārāja seṭṭhī gahapati mahāroruve niraye paccatīti.
sn3.20:4.9: evaṃ bhante seṭṭhī gahapati mahāroruvaṃ nirayaṃ upapannoti.
sn3.20:4.10: evaṃ mahārāja seṭṭhī gahapati mahāroruvaṃ nirayaṃ upapannoti.
